description: A stubby pneumatic speargun with a rubber-wrapped grip and a spare shaft clipped along the barrel. Built for salvage crews working the flooded blocks: it is the one weapon in this city that does not care that it is underwater, because underwater is the only place anyone ever meant to fire it.
name: Tidewell speargun
